newsitem.title: EGYPT: Arafat leaves Cairo for Gaza after talks with Mubarak.
newsitem.headline: Arafat leaves Cairo for Gaza after talks with Mubarak.

text.p: Palestinian President Yasser Arafat left Cairo on Monday for Gaza after talks with Egyptian President Hosni Mubarak on the Middle East peace process.

Airport sources reported the departure of the Palestinian leader, who had said late on Sunday that progress on peace between Israel and the Palestinians was hampered by the Jewish state's building of settlements in East Jerusalem.
